events.title: Steam Next Fest is live: play the MindGate CornerGet demo now
events.summary: Steam Next Fest has started. The MindGate CornerGet demo is ready to play right now.What kind of game is it?It is an idle loot-and-fight game played in a thin strip on your taskbar, where tiny characters take on the enemies. It keeps going even if you do nothing. Open the dashboard when you feel like it and swap in the gear that dropped. events.title: b952: Key Boss 3 “Keyward Skull”, magatama fusion and removal, new Enforcer art
events.summary: Key Boss 3 “Keyward Skull” added, and magatama can now be fused and removedWe added Key Boss 3, the Keyward Skull. We also improved how magatama are organized, gear comparison, the Enforcer’s art, and more.Key bosses• Key Boss 3, the Keyward Skull, appears at the shrine in Act 3. It is the Act 3 Gashadokuro, clad in golden bones and pale blue will-o’-wisps• You can challenge it after beating Key Bosses 1 and 2. events.title: The Night Parade is here (b950)
events.summary: A new mode, the Night Parade, is here. This update also brings skill fixes, bug fixes and display cleanup.The Night Parade• Available once you reach Act 2.• As you play, the moon at the top right of the screen fills up. Click the full moon to start a night: a battle of about 90 seconds in which you defend the torii from a horde of yokai• In the demo, you can store up to 3 moons• Nights 1 to 5 are available. events.title: Demo Update (b944)
events.summary: We have updated the demo based on your reports and what we noticed while playing. Thank you for sending them in.Fixes• Fixed a bug where you could not drag a reserve character back into the party on the Team screen. Dropping on an empty slot, on a deployed character, or on a formation slot now all return them to the party• Fixed chest and inventory behavior. events.summary: The free demo of MindGate CornerGet is now available on Steam.
